The guard text should explicitly scope the presence check to *data/training arms the run was supposed to produce*, and recognize that an analyzer-computed control is satisfied by computation, not by a pre-existing file.

3. 4. (Alternatives, Claude) The vacuous-pass default leaves a residual hole (a future plan that forgets to declare a control sails through). The guard text should include a one-line note that the protection is opt-in on plan declaration, so the limit is documented.

5. (Alternatives, Claude + Codex) Slug↔`eval_results/` matching is the one brittle surface; implementer should sanity-check against one concrete recent multi-arm `eval_results/issue_<M>/` layout (e.g. #658).
